title: Listing Highlight: 80' OKEAN 80 Flybridge 2021
description: Discover the elegance of the 2021 OKEAN 80 Flybridge Yacht, combining innovative design and cutting-edge features for an unparalleled yachting experience.
html:
Introducing the 2021 OKEAN 80 Flybridge Yacht

The 2021 OKEAN 80 Flybridge Yacht represents a sophisticated blend of design and functionality, offering a unique experience on the water. With its spacious layout and state-of-the-art features, this vessel is crafted to provide comfort and performance for both short trips and extended voyages. The OKEAN 80 stands out with its innovative design elements, making it a noteworthy option for those seeking a modern yachting experience.

Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Living Experience

A hallmark of the OKEAN 80 is its ability to harmonize indoor and outdoor spaces. The yacht’s deck doors open entirely, creating a fluid transition between the interior lounge and the open sea, accommodating up to 30 guests. This design philosophy extends to the Beach Club at the stern, where a submersible sliding platform offers versatile interactions with the ocean. This integration allows for safe diving, intense nature experiences, and comfortable returns to the vessel.

Innovative Hull and Deck Design Features

The OKEAN 80 is constructed with a focus on durability and performance. The hull and decks are built to CE Standards, utilizing advanced materials such as hybrid Kevlar-fiberglass laminates and carbon fiber encapsulated foam stringers. The yacht’s exterior is finished with a white isophthalic gel coat, providing a high-gloss finish with excellent weather resistance. Natural teak on the main deck and flybridge, along with ESTHEC on the swim platform, enhances both the aesthetic and functional aspects of the yacht.

Luxurious Aft Deck, Transom, and Beach Club

The aft deck of the OKEAN 80 is designed for both relaxation and practicality, featuring seating with storage access and a freshwater shower at the transom Beach Club. The area is equipped with a refrigerator, icemaker, and indirect lighting, creating an inviting atmosphere. The Beach Club includes molded sofa seating with storage, and the swim platform is equipped with a multifunctional gangway and tender lift, ensuring ease of access and versatility.


Advanced Flybridge and Salon Amenities

The flybridge of the OKEAN 80 is equipped with modern amenities, including a complete bar with an electric grill and a large seating area with an extendable wood table. The helm features advanced navigation and control systems, including SIMRAD displays and joystick maneuvering. The salon offers a 360° view through tinted, tempered glass windows and includes a multi-zone stereo system, ensuring an immersive entertainment experience.

Comprehensive Mechanical and Electrical Systems

The mechanical and electrical systems of the OKEAN 80 are designed for reliability and efficiency. Twin MAN V12 engines provide substantial power, while the yacht’s propulsion system includes hydraulic bow and stern thrusters for precise maneuvering. The vessel is equipped with a chilled-water HVAC system for climate control, and its electrical system features LED lighting and a digital control system for seamless operation.

A Masterpiece of Modern Nautical Engineering

The 2021 OKEAN 80 Flybridge Yacht is a testament to contemporary nautical engineering, offering a blend of innovative design, advanced technology, and practical functionality. This vessel is well-suited for those who value both performance and comfort in their maritime pursuits.
